visualCharacteristics.variantDescriptor: 4-up cards with black-to-grey gradient card background, image on top, white centered text; optional title, pill CTA button and description, or caption only.
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Grid of dark gradient cards for products/tours or captioned image demos

contentPattern.structure: one row per card: cell 1 image; cell 2 rich text (title paragraph, CTA link paragraph, description paragraph) or a single caption line
contentPattern.description: 4 tour/product cards (title, RESERVE NOW / BUY NOW CTA, description) and several rows of captioned image cards (Original image, Crop variants, Flip, Colorize, ...).

usage: Use for rows of product/tour teasers or captioned image comparisons on a dark gradient card shell.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for gradient-shell cards with image on top and centered text. Use cards-image-top for borderless light cards.
